payload.blocks: Running `fgos migrate portfolio` (the data move), the head-grant swap and reference rewrite after it, and so phase 7. Phase 6 lands independently.
payload.headline: Phase 5: add the host operation catalog to the footprint so `fgos migrate portfolio` is admitted?

parts.cause: q-exu5x27hbq added the route files, but every native verb also needs one row in the operation catalog; the earlier list missed it. No other file is needed: the authority policy id is a plain string.

options.cost: One footprint commit and one short unit.
options.does: Supervisor/planner adds packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs to the footprint; a unit adds the one descriptor and the id to its test.
options.gain: The verb works for every project (mission #1 upgrade path) as phase 5 promises.
options.harm: One more shared host file in this plan's footprint.
options.label: Add catalog.rs (recommended)

options.cost: A new backlog item; dead routing until then.
options.does: Move this repo's data with the migration's library code from a test path; external projects get the verb in a new item.
options.harm: Routing already done stays unreachable; mission #1 projects have no upgrade path.
options.label: Run the move without the verb

parts.recommendation: Add packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs to the footprint; the lead then finishes the verb and runs the data move.

scope.allows: One operation descriptor for migrate.portfolio and its id in that file's catalog test.
scope.forbids: Any other change to the catalog or the host runtime.

parts.what: The verb is now routed on branch work-data-model/p05e (8980311b7: registry entry, route contracts, main.rs, cli_projector, routing); its 18 migrate tests pass. But the host's admission gate refuses any operation not listed in packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs (authority_gate.rs: 'Operation must exist in catalog'), and that file is not in the plan footprint. One OperationDescriptor (migrate.portfolio, owner packaging, Write, cli only), mirroring init.run, plus its id in the same file's catalog test.
